content.what_this_is: This is an electricity bill from NorthPower Energy for October 2026.
what_to_do: Pay the bill online at northpower.example.
You can also pay by phone on 0300 000 0000.
You can also set up a Direct Debit with the form enclosed.
Call 0300 000 0001 if you struggle to pay. They can help.

by_when.what: Pay the bill. After this date there may be a late payment fee.

amounts.what: Late payment fee if you do not pay

safety_lines: Get free advice before you sign or pay. For example, Citizens Advice.
